workflows.name: concept_path_exploration_and_reweighting
workflows.intent: Find, visualize, and refine shortest paths between two sets of biological concepts in SemMedDB using custom edge weights and node filtering.
input: g_small (igraph object representing the SemMedDB graph)
e_feat (tibble of edge features extracted from the graph)
workflows.stages:
1. Search and filter source and target nodes using find_nodes().
2. Find initial shortest paths between the node sets using find_paths().
3. Inspect specific paths using text_path() and plot_path().
4. Extract edge features using get_edge_features().
5. Generate custom edge weights using make_edge_weights() to discourage uninformative nodes/semantic types (e.g., "humn", "popg") and encourage target types (e.g., "gngm", "aapp").
6. Optionally extract and block middle nodes of initial paths using get_middle_nodes() to force the discovery of alternative, longer paths.
7. Re-run find_paths() with the custom weights.
8. Summarize the semantic types and predicates along the discovered paths using summarize_semtypes() and summarize_predicates().
workflows.code:
library(rsemmed)

data(g_small)

nodes_sickle <- find_nodes(g_small, pattern = "sickle")
nodes_sickle <- nodes_sickle[c(1,3,5)]

nodes_malaria <- find_nodes(g_small, pattern = "malaria")
nodes_malaria <- nodes_malaria %>%
    find_nodes(pattern = "anti", match = FALSE) %>%
    find_nodes(pattern = "test", match = FALSE) %>%
    find_nodes(pattern = "screening", match = FALSE) %>%
    find_nodes(pattern = "pigment", match = FALSE) %>%
    find_nodes(pattern = "smear", match = FALSE) %>%
    find_nodes(pattern = "parasite", match = FALSE) %>%
    find_nodes(pattern = "serology", match = FALSE) %>%
    find_nodes(pattern = "vaccine", match = FALSE)

paths <- find_paths(graph = g_small, from = nodes_sickle, to = nodes_malaria)

this_path <- paths[[1]][[100]]
tp <- text_path(g_small, this_path)
plot_path(g_small, this_path)

e_feat <- get_edge_features(g_small)

paths_subset <- find_paths(
    graph = g_small,
    from = find_nodes(g_small, names = "sickle trait"),
    to = find_nodes(g_small, names = "Malaria, Cerebral")
)
paths_subset <- paths_subset[[1]]

w <- make_edge_weights(g_small, e_feat, node_semtypes_out = c("humn", "popg"))

paths_subset_reweight <- find_paths(
    graph = g_small,
    from = find_nodes(g_small, names = "sickle trait"),
    to = find_nodes(g_small, names = "Malaria, Cerebral"),
    weights = w
)

out_names <- get_middle_nodes(g_small, paths_subset)

w <- make_edge_weights(g_small, e_feat,
    node_names_out = out_names, node_semtypes_out = c("humn", "popg")
)

paths_subset_reweight <- find_paths(
    graph = g_small,
    from = find_nodes(g_small, pattern = "sickle trait"),
    to = find_nodes(g_small, pattern = "Malaria, Cerebral"),
    weights = w
)
paths_subset_reweight <- paths_subset_reweight[[1]]

get_middle_nodes(g_small, paths, collapse = FALSE)

w <- make_edge_weights(g_small, e_feat,
    node_semtypes_out = c("humn", "popg"),
    node_semtypes_in = c("gngm", "aapp")
)

paths_subset_reweight <- find_paths(
    graph = g_small,
    from = find_nodes(g_small, pattern = "sickle trait"),
    to = find_nodes(g_small, pattern = "Malaria, Cerebral"),
    weights = w
)
paths_subset_reweight <- paths_subset_reweight[[1]]

semtype_summary <- summarize_semtypes(g_small, paths_subset_reweight)
summarize_semtypes(g_small, paths)
edge_summary <- summarize_predicates(g_small, paths)

workflows.name: node_neighborhood_expansion
workflows.intent: Expand a seed set of biological concepts to discover directly connected neighboring concepts and filter them.
input: g_small (igraph object representing the SemMedDB graph)
workflows.stages:
1. Identify seed nodes of interest using find_nodes().
2. Expand the seed nodes to their 1-neighborhood using grow_nodes().
3. Summarize the semantic types of the neighboring nodes using summarize_semtypes() with is_path = FALSE.
4. Filter out uninteresting neighbor nodes by pattern, semantic type, or exact name using find_nodes() with match = FALSE.
workflows.code:
library(rsemmed)

data(g_small)

nodes_sickle <- find_nodes(g_small, pattern = "sickle")
nodes_sickle_trait <- nodes_sickle[2:3]

nbrs_sickle_trait <- grow_nodes(g_small, nodes_sickle_trait)

nbrs_sickle_trait_summ <- summarize_semtypes(g_small, nbrs_sickle_trait, is_path = FALSE)

nbrs_sickle_trait2 <- nbrs_sickle_trait %>%
    find_nodes(
        pattern = "^Mice",
        semtypes = c("humn", "popg", "plnt", 
            "fish", "food", "edac", "dora", "aggp"),
        names = c("Polymerase Chain Reaction", "Mus"),
        match = FALSE
    )
